questions.prompt:
1) Ravi goes to Kumar’s house as a guest. While Kumar is in another room,
Ravi sees Kumar’s gold ring on the table. Ravi dishonestly puts the ring in his
pocket and leaves the house without Kumar’s consent. What offence has Ravi
committed?

2) Karthik is walking on the road while holding his mobile phone in his hand.
Suresh suddenly comes on a bike, grabs the mobile phone from Karthik’s
hand, and quickly escapes. What offence has Suresh committed?

3) Ramesh threatens to publish a false and defamatory statement about Kumar
unless Kumar gives him ₹50,000. Out of fear, Kumar gives the money to
Ramesh. What offence has Ramesh committed?

4) Ravi takes Kumar’s mobile phone from his hand. When Kumar tries to stop
him, Ravi pushes Kumar down, causes hurt, and runs away with the phone.
What offence has Ravi committed?

5) Ravi, Suresh, Mohan, Karthik and Bala stop Kumar on a road. They threaten
him with knives and forcibly take away his gold chain and mobile phone. What
offence have they committed?

6) Arun sees that Kumar accidentally drops his purse containing money on the
road. Arun first picks it up thinking that he will return it to Kumar, but later
decides to keep the money for himself. What offence has Arun committed?

7) Ravi gives his laptop to Suresh for safe custody while he goes out of
station. Suresh promises to return it after one month. Instead, Suresh
dishonestly sells the laptop and uses the money for himself. What offence has
Suresh committed?

8) Ravi steals Kumar’s mobile phone and sells it to Suresh for a very low price.
Suresh knows that the phone was stolen, but still buys it and keeps it. What
offence has Suresh committed?
choices: b) Dishonestly receiving or retaining stolen property

questions.prompt:
9) Ravi falsely tells Kumar that he is a government officer and asks Kumar to
give him a costly mobile phone on credit. Ravi already knows that he has no
intention to pay for it. What offence has Ravi committed?

10) Ravi goes to a bank and falsely introduces himself as Kumar, a rich
businessman. Believing Ravi’s false identity, the bank officer allows him to
obtain a loan. What offence has Ravi committed?

11) Ravi gets angry with Kumar and intentionally breaks the glass windows of
Kumar’s shop, causing damage to the shop property. What offence has Ravi
committed?

12) Ravi enters Kumar’s private agricultural land without permission, intending
to threaten Kumar and annoy him because of a previous dispute. What offence
has Ravi committed?

13) Ravi wants to enter Kumar’s house to commit theft. Instead of using the
main door, Ravi makes a hole in the wall of Kumar’s house and puts his hand
inside to take a gold chain kept near the wall. What offence has Ravi
committed?

14) Ravi digs a deep pit on a walking path and covers it with leaves, knowing
that a person walking there may fall into it and die. Kumar walks over it, falls
into the pit, and dies. What offence has Ravi committed?

15) Ravi points a loaded gun at Kumar and shoots him in the chest with the
intention of killing him. Kumar dies on the spot. What offence has Ravi
committed?

16) Ravi wants to kill Kumar. He shoots at Kumar, but the bullet misses Kumar
and hits Suresh, who was standing nearby. Suresh dies. Which provision
applies to Ravi’s act?
choices: a) Culpable homicide by causing death of person other than intended person

questions.prompt:
17) Ravi drives his car at very high speed in a crowded market area without
proper care. He loses control and hits Kumar, who dies due to the accident.
Ravi had no intention to kill Kumar. What offence has Ravi committed?

18) Ravi repeatedly instigates Kumar to end his life and tells him that suicide is
the only solution to his problems. Because of Ravi’s instigation, Kumar
commits suicide. What offence has Ravi committed?

19) Ravi slaps Kumar during a quarrel. Kumar suffers bodily pain, but there is
no fracture or serious injury. What has Ravi caused?

20) Ravi angrily punches Kumar on his face during a quarrel, intending to
cause bodily pain. Kumar suffers pain and swelling, but no fracture. What
offence has Ravi committed?

21) Ravi hits Kumar on his face with a stone during a fight. Kumar’s tooth is
fractured because of the blow. Which category of hurt is caused?

22) Ravi intentionally hits Kumar’s face with an iron rod, knowing that the blow
is likely to permanently disfigure Kumar’s face. Kumar suffers permanent
facial disfiguration. What offence has Ravi committed?

23) Ravi blocks a public pathway through which Kumar has a lawful right to
walk. Ravi does not believe in good faith that he has any right to block the
path. Kumar is prevented from going through that path. What offence has Ravi
committed?

24) Ravi asks Kumar to enter a room and then locks the door from outside.
Kumar is unable to leave the room and cannot move beyond the room’s four
walls. What offence has Ravi committed?

25) Ravi intentionally pushes Kumar in a crowded street without Kumar’s
consent, intending to annoy and frighten him. What offence has Ravi
committed?
